scope: Offline repair only; no ROS node, CAN, SDK construction, restart or hardware command.

contract.valid_until: Earliest actual status/joint/motor source-health deadline; old command lease excluded.
contract.command_active: True only after a successful external joint command while its monotonic lease remains valid.
contract.healthy_hold: No CAN send, disable, latch or accepted-source barrier advance. A new plan may span an old command lease if its own validation passes.
contract.preserved: Explicit enable ordering, successful-command source monotonicity, <300ms command age, <=.03rad target lead, true health failures, stop latch, initial-command timeout and send-failure checks remain.

new_coverage: Old lease has only 5ms left without clipping source-health deadline.
Normal expiry retains last accepted source stamp and emits no CAN command.
A newer independently fresh command begun before old lease expiry is accepted, including expiry handled in the joint callback.
Accepted-message replay and >300ms commands remain rejected.
Healthy active-to-hold transition does not change MPPI authority epoch.
Actual source-health gap during solving invalidates the plan even after fresh recovery.

limitations: No physical or live timing validation in this task.
Recorded map/reference failures remain independent; this patch does not make unavailable collision input executable.
